Interface RecipeExtension

All Known Subinterfaces:
CompressionExtension, CraftingExtension, DefaultExtension, RemovalExtension, SmeltingExtension, SmithingExtension, StoneCuttingExtension, ToolExtension
All Known Implementing Classes:
RecipeProviderBase
public interface RecipeExtension
A recipe extension is an interface that provides logic for a RecipeProviderBase. Custom recipe extension should extend this interface and then add default methods to be used in RecipeProviderBase.setup(). As RecipeProviderBase implements this interface as well, the abstract methods are then filled with logic.

Additionally, a recipe extension class can define a public static method named setup that takes a ModX and an extension with the same type as the class that defines the method. When a RecipeProviderBase implements that extension, it'll call that setup method during setup.
